(By Shri Manoj Jain - Advocate For Respondent No.1) This appeal coming on for
conciliation this day, the Bench passed the following:

AWARD This appeal by the appellant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Ac t is arising out of the award dated 07.08.2013 passed by First Addtional Member,
MACT, Neemuch, District Neemuch in Claim Case No.82/2013 and has been placed before this Lok Adalat u/s. 20 of the Legal Services & Authorities Act, 1987.
Both the parties have agreed to settle the appeal as per the terms of compromise filed by the parties.
The amount of Rs.2,00,000/- is enhanced.
The enhanced compensation will be paid without interest within two months and the amount which is due for payment shall be paid with interest at the rate of 9% (nine percent) per annum.
